intro.text: The palace of the Lord Ruler in Luthadel, heavily guarded and wrapped in an oppressive air.
The ruined palace of the Lord Ruler in Luthadel, its remains driven into the ground within a large crater.

description.text: Standing near the palace brings a heavy sense of depression, like a strong, constant Soothing, which comes from the Lord Ruler himself. Armoured guards drawn from the Luthadel Garrison and a strong force of hazekillers defend it.

The palace bristles with peaked spires and sheer towers of many thicknesses: some hold large rooms and stairwells, others are thin iron rods. It has no outer defensive walls, and was built with materials and methods known only to the Steel Ministry.

One part holds a great domed room painted with murals, among them a mountain, a cavern, a pool of light and something very dark. At its centre stands a small, single-storey stone building carved with flowing patterns, its wooden door inscribed with words probably in ancient Terris.

items.text: Years earlier, Kelsier, Mare and Redd broke into the palace but were discovered. Redd was killed on the spot, and Kelsier and Mare were sent to the Pits of Hathsin.
Kelsier and Vin slipped in again but were chased off by Steel Inquisitors. Vin was badly hurt, and Sazed saved her with Feruchemy. They got away with a book taken from one of the palace rooms.

On another night, Vin entered alone and was captured by the Inquisitor Kar, held in a cell and questioned in a throne room. Freed by Sazed and Elend, she crashed back into the throne room through a huge stained-glass window and, with Marsh's help, fought the Lord Ruler there and killed him.
Having become Preservation, Vin destroyed the palace while fighting Ruin's last Inquisitors. Its remains were forced into the ground inside a large crater.
Independence Tower, a skyscraper in the city of Bilming, is often called the Shaw after the old palace.
